title: Kotlin Multiplatform, from the compiler up
intro: How one Kotlin codebase runs on Android and on an iPhone that has no JVM, what Swift actually sees of your code, how memory and threads behave on iOS, and how Compose Multiplatform draws your UI there. Built from the compiler up, one small puzzle at a time.
how: Each puzzle starts with a problem shared code has to solve, gives you one building block, shows it in a diagram that plays itself, and ends with three questions you have to answer to unlock the next one. Facts come from Kotlin's own documentation, linked on every page.
heroAlt: Animated diagram: one Kotlin file goes through the compiler's front end and comes out as JVM bytecode for Android and native code for an iPhone.

modules.title: Module 1: One codebase, two worlds
modules.blurb: From one source file to two kinds of machine code, how Kotlin reaches Apple's code, what an iOS app is, and how Swift sees what you built.

modules.title: Module 2: Living on iOS
modules.blurb: How memory is freed on each side and where that breaks, the main thread on iOS, coroutines there, and shipping one framework.

modules.title: Module 3: Sharing the UI
modules.blurb: Compose from its one core idea, what Compose Multiplatform shares, and how it draws on iOS.

modules.title: Module 4: The build
modules.blurb: What the kotlin { } block declares, the tree of source sets between commonMain and each target, who can see what, where each library goes, how one dependency line reaches every target, and when to choose expect/actual or an interface.

upcoming.title: Module 5: Kotlin/Native under the hood
upcoming.topics: From IR to LLVM to a binary; framework vs XCFramework, static vs dynamic; debug symbols, crash reports and symbolication; build time and binary size.

upcoming.title: Module 6: Across the boundary
upcoming.topics: Objective-C export limits (generics, sealed classes, default arguments), @Throws and exceptions, suspend functions and Flow from Swift, SKIE and Swift export.

upcoming.title: Module 7: Shipping it to iOS
upcoming.topics: Swift Package Manager, CocoaPods or direct integration; embedAndSign; versioning a shared module.

upcoming.title: Module 8: The common stack
upcoming.topics: Ktor engines, kotlinx.serialization, SQLDelight, settings, Koin; ViewModel in commonMain; testing in commonTest and on iOS.
